operator.name: GpuSbeSourceOp
operator.description: FIX SBE market data over DAQIRI GPUDirect: frames land in GPU memory, a GIL-free native drain gathers the UDP payloads into a device ring, and the source decodes SBE on the GPU (one warp per packet, one lane per entry) into device-resident event batches.

changelog.0.2.0: Holoscan SDK 5.0 operator with typed ports, Params and a temporal contract.

hardware.name: CUDA GPU
hardware.description: GPUDirect RDMA target (dma-buf); the ring, gather and SBE decode run on it

hardware.name: NVIDIA ConnectX NIC
hardware.description: Received through DAQIRI (Python bindings, DPDK engine) into GPU memory; needs hugepages

hardware.name: daqiri Python module
hardware.description: The daqiri Python module with the DPDK engine (deploy/igx_thor builds it); its absence fails start() explicitly
